'''Troy Biesterfeld''' (forums handle '''tbiesty''') created the Star Wars CCG implementation of [[GEMP]], the online play platform of the [[Players Committee]]. In June 2018 he stepped away from the project, and the PC took over its management.<ref name="gemp2018">[https://web.archive.org/web/20201128163934/https://www.starwarsccg.org/gemp-announcements-request-for-applications-for-new-team/ GEMP Announcements &amp; Request for Applications for New Team], starwarsccg.org (7 June 2018; Wayback, 28 November 2020)</ref> The Community Card lists him as a 2017 Advocate Award winner, "Creator of GEMP".<ref name="card">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html Community Card], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012004011/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html Wayback 12 October 2026]</ref>
